description: This PHP class defines the ORM entity 'OpenIdUserIdentity' which maps to the database table 'ohrm_openid_user_identity'. It represents the association between a user, an OpenID provider, and the user's OpenID identity within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: OpenIdUserIdentity
classes.description: An ORM entity class that links a User, an OpenIdProvider, and a user identity string for OpenID authentication.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User object for this identity.

methods.name: setOpenIdProvider
methods.description: Sets the OpenIdProvider object for this identity.

methods.name: getUserIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves the user's OpenID identity string.

methods.name: setUserIdentity
methods.description: Sets the user's OpenID identity string.
